EXPLANATION: The spectrum shows an OH stretch near 3328–3385 cm⁻¹ (GFQ-001, with hydrogen-bonding broadening per ENV-001), strong CH stretches at 2967/2905/2828 cm⁻¹ (GFQ-003), a very strong band at ~1037 cm⁻¹ consistent with the C–O stretch of an alcohol, and a CH₃ deformation near 1479 cm⁻¹ (within the C–H bending range per GFQ-003). This pattern is characteristic of methanol (CO) and fits better than amines (which would also show NH bending near ~1600 cm⁻¹, GFQ-002, not observed).
